Published: 🚀 Orchestrated KMP releases across both store publishers, and added a read-only App Store Connect build status workflow that also reports build upload errors

⚡ Sped up KMP CI by running unit tests and lint as parallel jobs, publishing cache bundles only on misses with stable keys, and pinning a working ORAS version so caches restore and publish again

🐛 Fixed the TARS release refusing the stable Runpod endpoint when it was idle, by accepting a zero worker ceiling while still rejecting other unexpected values
🐛 Treated missing worker and pod lists on an idle Runpod endpoint as empty, while still flagging them as errors on enabled endpoints, and updated the test fake to match Runpod's real response
🚀 Added an early read of the newest install day to the install-paid email, shown as a provisional comparison against the prior 7 days; it is optional and failures leave the email unchanged

Published: 🐛 Fixed ta-render aborting at exit on NVIDIA EGL workers by releasing EGL thread state and terminating the display after render and self-test on Linux
🔧 Added exit-path logging for GL commands, covering EGL teardown, its result and the exit code, to make late process failures easier to diagnose

🐛 Fixed a crash on exit with NVIDIA's Linux EGL driver that made self-test fail and workers miss startup qualification; GL commands now end with a direct libc _exit on Linux, with a normal exit fallback elsewhere
♻️ Moved scratch directory cleanup into a shared exit cleanup used by both the shutdown hook and the _exit path
✅ Verified on Linux with Mesa: exit codes for success, failed render and GL failure behave correctly, no scratch directory is left behind, and the test suites pass

Published: 🐛 GPU qualification now forwards the JVM's crash report when a self-test fails, including the problematic frame, native stack and captured stdout, so aborts at exit are no longer reduced to a bare exit code
🔧 Self-test now runs with settings that route fatal messages and the crash report to readable locations, and the diagnostic length cap was raised so long output is kept
🐛 Forwarded crash reports now include the current thread, signal info, Java stack and thread lists, so a crash can be matched to a named thread, while boilerplate is trimmed
🚀 Failed qualifications now record the signal by name, whether the GL probe had already passed, and an environment line with driver, animator and Java versions
